title: mms: Fix ASN.1 typo for variableAccessSpecification
description:
The ASN.1 spec for MMS is already modified to pass asn2wrs and
other specs found online does not have this typo.

Fix #21035

-	variableAccessSpecificatn	[1] VariableAccessSpecification
+	variableAccessSpecification	[1] VariableAccessSpecification
 	}
 
 
 Read-Response ::= SEQUENCE
 	{
-	variableAccessSpecificatn [0] VariableAccessSpecification OPTIONAL,
-	listOfAccessResult	  [1] IMPLICIT SEQUENCE OF AccessResult
